★ Request
Show Fusaichi Pandora (Summer Uniform)
Playing with red guitar (prop1561_00) and pick (prop1567_00).
Ah, don't make that face like you've heard it a million times alreadyyyy! Jeez, come oooon!

Fusaichi Pandora shows me the picture she drew.
What was depicted there was――
Sketching♪
A! F-u-n! P-l-a-c-e! ♡

What!? Grrr, look at that mischievous smirk on your face!!
Fine then, I'm totally gonna do it too!!

...Heheh.
Hey, guess what! I found it! My absolute favorite h-o-b-b-y♡
It happened during our free time at summer training camp.

As expected of Fusaichi Pandora. I haven't even finished half of mine yet.
I frantically move my brush, but... it looks like it'll take a while to finish.

Something I can believe in... Something I never, ever want to let go of――
――That's why!

If you take turns, you can participate as a pair!
Though... that one's the hardest to knock down. Think you can drop it~?

All riiiight! Then for the grand finale――that one♪
Let's do this, here we gooo!!

Told ya so~♡ Aren't I just a genius-level cutie♡
And the shooting gallery was pretty fun, too♡

Shooting was something she claimed she'd gotten bored of before, if I recalled correctly.
Before I could wonder what had changed――
Wha―― Just like that...?! For real――

I still couldn't fully grasp what she was aiming for.
Still――I figured it didn't matter. Because she was having fun.
Ehehe! Look at you trying your best♪
You know, I finally found it!
Don't you dare let me get bored, okay? ♡

It's fine! Hey... wait, are you not gonna try?
Are you not gonna do it~~? Heyyyy!

Surprised by the sudden topic, I stop my hands. There might be a reason why
she gave something she had supposedly grown bored of――another try.
Huh~? Don't worry about it, take your time.

Ah~ That's... don't worry about it!
Come on, you gotta decide what you're making too♪

! Hehehe. ...Hey, then I'll give you mine,
so give me yours! Deal, right? ♡

Aww~♡ The one you made is super-duper cuuute!
Wait, doesn't it kind of look like me??
――Hey, Trainer! Grant my selfish wish, okay? ♪

Oho, wanna challenge me?
Just so you know, you're looking at a contest champion~!
(Pop!)

Totally♡ And like, that slight adjustment just now was suuuper nice?
...Down it goes! ♡
Huh!? ...S-She rotated the target around with a single shot!

Congraaaatulations!!
Here is your priiiiize!!

...It seems she has something on her mind.
For now, let's try making a plushie.

Hmmmm?
...Well, since you put it like that~
...Yeah, I thought so.
T-h-a-t's... a secret――
――But, you know. It ended up totally boring after all.
(P-P-Pop!)

Pheeew... Too bad! It just grazed the top.
All right! Just one shot left~!!
And so――the plushie was successfully completed.
(Pop!)

All right! Has everyone received their plushie fabric?
Then let's decide on which animal to make next! After that, the patterns――

Whoa!! Look, look!!
Isn't that prize hand mirror super-duper pink and totally cute!?

Woooow~♡ Isn't this suuuper stylish!?
Well!! Does it suit me?? Super cute, right~??

"Like that plushie sewing class...
On the very first day, mine was used as the class example――"

It was just soooo much fun back then,
that I tried playing it all by myself at the dorm, too!
We played guitar together before, right? Remember?
This!!

And then, it hit me.
The real reason why I've been having so much fun lately!

I'm gonna make a doggy! It looks like you♡
...Huh, what's up? Ah, did that actually make you mad? Wait, are you a cat person?

Hey, hey, hey, there's a place I wanna go!
Come with me! Pretty please? Come on, come on!

――All right, finished♪
How about you, Trainer... already done?

All right, finally finished one ear~!!
...Ugh... doing the other one sounds like such a drag~. Break time~.

Mmm~~! So cool in here♪
We can totally do this in here even if it's crazy hot outside, right――
